about.title: About us
about.body: {name} is a learning centre that prepares students for the digital SAT. This site holds the practice materials our teachers write, so you can study between lessons.
about.contentBody: Questions on this site are written by our teachers, or used with written permission from their authors. Some draft questions may be prepared with AI help, but a teacher checks every question before it is published. We do not copy questions from the College Board or other prep companies.
about.scoreBody: Any score we show is an estimate based on your practice, not an official College Board score.

official.a: No. Our questions are written by our teachers in the style of the digital SAT. For official practice, use the free College Board and Khan Academy materials linked on our Official resources page.

score.q: Is the score you show my real SAT score?
score.a: No. It is an estimate based on your practice. Only the College Board can give you an official score.

language.a: Yes. The real SAT is in English, and so is Satify: questions, explanations, study plans and messages.

device.q: Can I practise on my phone?
device.a: Yes. The real test is taken on a laptop or tablet, so try to do full timed practice on one of those.

mistake.q: I think a question has a mistake. What do I do?
mistake.a: Use the “Report a problem” button after you answer. A teacher reviews every report.

UNCERTAIN_TEXT.label: Uncertain text
UNCERTAIN_TEXT.help: Some characters were hard to read. Check text marked like [[?this]] and remove the marker.

CHOICE_COUNT.label: Not 4 choices
CHOICE_COUNT.help: Multiple-choice questions need exactly four filled choices A–D.

ANSWER_NOT_IN_CHOICES.label: Answer not a choice
ANSWER_NOT_IN_CHOICES.help: The correct answer must be one of A, B, C or D.

INVALID_SPR_ANSWER.label: Invalid answer format
INVALID_SPR_ANSWER.help: Student-produced answers must be numbers, decimals or fractions, e.g. 3, -1.5, 7/2.

MISSING_FIGURE.label: Missing figure?
MISSING_FIGURE.help: The text mentions a figure, graph or table but none is attached.

DUPLICATE_CODE.label: Code reassigned
DUPLICATE_CODE.help: The code in the file was already used, so a new one was given.

NEAR_DUPLICATE.label: Near-duplicate
NEAR_DUPLICATE.help: Very similar to another question in the bank.

TAXONOMY_UNCONFIRMED.label: Confirm domain/skill
TAXONOMY_UNCONFIRMED.help: Domain and skill were suggested automatically. Check them and save the question, or use “Confirm domain and skill” in the review queue.

STUDENT_REPORT.label: Student report
STUDENT_REPORT.help: A student reported a problem with this question.

DIFFICULTY_MISMATCH.label: Difficulty mismatch
DIFFICULTY_MISMATCH.help: Student accuracy doesn’t match the difficulty label.

AI_KEY_DISPUTE.label: AI questions the answer
AI_KEY_DISPUTE.help: When explaining this question to a student, the AI tutor thought the answer key might be wrong. Check the answer; approving or saving the question clears this flag.

AI_UNREVIEWED.label: AI draft — needs reading
AI_UNREVIEWED.help: Written by AI. Open it in the editor, check every word, the answer and the explanation, then save. It can't be published before that.

AI_SOLVER_DISAGREES.label: Solver got another answer
AI_SOLVER_DISAGREES.help: A second, independent AI pass solved this draft without the key and got a different answer.

AI_AMBIGUOUS.label: Possibly ambiguous
AI_AMBIGUOUS.help: The independent solver thought the question is unclear or has more than one correct answer.

MATH_CHECK_FAILED.label: Math check failed
MATH_CHECK_FAILED.help: The automatic calculation of this draft's answer did not match the key.

ANSWER_PATTERN.label: Students prefer another answer
ANSWER_PATTERN.help: With 30+ answers, one wrong choice is picked more often than the keyed answer. Check the key and the wording; approving clears this flag.
